notes: Reconciled with the second labeller (see reconciliation.md). The final judgement is the structured label; notes_blind_original keeps the pre-reconciliation blind notes, which are historical and superseded wherever they conflict with the final label.
notes_blind_original: Values confirmed in the published Supplementary Information (static-content.springer.com, MOESM1, Supplementary Table 2). The report's Table 1 'Original' column is captioned as 'the original calculations in the paper', so it may quote the paper rather than show the re-run output; the reproduction verdict comes from the general statement in section 2.1. Its 'Original' tree p-value for human children (1.51e-1) differs from the printed 1.1520e-01, probably a transcription slip; trees are not claimed. The code sets set.seed(123) before the 1000-replicate Monte Carlo z-scores, so the values are deterministic. Mislabelling in the deposit and SI (P3, no numeric consequence): printed Supplementary Table 2 values are the one-sample Wilcoxon tests of normalized z-scores vs 0 (ST1a_plots.R writes these to 'tableS3.csv'), whereas the shipped 'tableS2.csv' holds the paired pyramid-vs-tree test, and the SI Table 2 caption describes the paired test. A checker matching by file name will find different numbers. The report's Z-score normalization finding (code normalizes across metrics within study, unlike the text's equation 3) is a code-vs-description inconsistency. It does not stop the shipped code reproducing the printed values, but a reconciler could treat it as a P2/P3 methods-description issue.
